newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian cen. bank sells 430 bln rbls bills, bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russian cen. bank sells 430 bln rbls bills, bonds.

text.p: The central bank sold 429.98 billion roubles nominal of GKO discount Treasury bills and OFZ interest-bearing government bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Thursday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:

The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 22081 issue closed on Thursday at 89.31 percent, the 22085 issue closed at 88.60 percent, the 23007 issue closed at 86.30 percent, the 21076 issue closed at 85.16 percent, the 21078 issue closed at 84.60 percent, the 21079 issue closed at 84.22 percent and the 25016 issue closed at 100.59 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the central bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
